notes: Each row is now reproducible: determinism was verified in exp_c17 (bit-identical checkpoints), so re-running any seed returns its number exactly. The 500 sd is therefore seed sensitivity, not run noise.

The spread is LARGE: sd 500 on a mean of 4308 is 12% of the score, and the min-max gap is 1335. Any A/B on this config that moves the mean by less than ~408 at 6 seeds is not measurable. See diag_seeds.py for the why.

exp_c15 measured this same config at 3 seeds WITHOUT determinism and got 4318.5 +/- 178.0. That sd was contaminated by run noise (exp_c16: 663 at a fixed seed) and should be read as superseded, not as agreeing or disagreeing with this one.
